problem_type: <str> Type identifier for the optimization problem.
n: <int> Number of customers to be served.
d: <int> Number of depots from which vehicles operate.
t: <int> Number of periods (days) in the planning horizon.
m: <int> Number of identical vehicles stationed at each depot.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total demand a single vehicle can carry on one route.
route_duration_limit: <int> Maximum total duration of a single route, including travel times and service times.

depots.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of this depot in the service area.
depots.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of this depot in the service area.

customers.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of this customer in the service area.
customers.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of this customer in the service area.
customers.demand: <int> Quantity of goods to be delivered to this customer on each visit.
customers.service_duration: <int> Time spent at this customer's site during each visit.
customers.frequency: <int> Number of times this customer must be visited over the planning horizon.
customers.pattern_list: <list[list[int]], length varies> Feasible visit patterns for this customer, where each pattern is a list of 1-based period indices on which visits occur.
